14: דעלה קאי It stands adjacent - It [therefore] removes them (i.e., the deaf-mute, imbecile, and minor). What, then, is implied by "and all of those"? It also comes to teach that there are others [who are included in the rule], for [if it meant to refer back to the deaf-mute, imbecile, and minor] it should have taught, "and if they slaughtered."
